The '''Gossam alphabet''' was the written form of the [[Gossam (language)/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] of [[Castell/Legends|Castell]]. The script was composed of jagged letters, which were combined to create short words and long sentences.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
